head: 71ec455a18702fe695d0c924a535ff9f385bd58d
scope: Manual local NFV-methodology audit: seven new selected whole properties, not verdicts or official hosted-driver output
numbering: P11-P17 are distinct from the immutable first-batch P1-P10

properties.grounding_quote: // every position is a determined mismatch: the needle
properties.inputs: X,Y,Z: seq<int>; a,b: int; three distinct non-unit AST identities separate from word valuations
domain: one active obligation [X,unit(a),Y] not-contains [X,unit(b),Z]; no earlier conflict or substitution
required_helpers: Faithful pointer/kind-aware compare_alignment, not comparison of word valuations
Complete token-window scan and actual all-mismatch discharge decision
Body-defined word containment and valuation/flattening helpers
correspondence_limits: Specific token shape, not all containment propagation
No preceding facet/caller reachability, native result, source fix or crash claim
This is a different branch from the published prefix-pruning model
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.inputs: pattern_length, case_number: int representing 32-bit unsigned values; output admitted: bool
domain: the selected source prelude has a valid active replacement obligation and nonempty literal pattern
properties.whole_positive_property: admitted == (case_number < 2 * pattern_length + 2), with the specification arithmetic mathematical and the source computation modulo 4294967296
required_helpers: Body-defined unsigned-32 arithmetic for the actual expression 2*p.length()+2
Source guard observation only: admitted iff the guard does not return false
correspondence_limits: Checks branch-number admission only, not replacement semantics, iterator exhaustion or all index bounds
32-bit unsigned target model; no assumption that 2*pattern_length+2 does not wrap
No huge literal allocation is performed or proved possible. Any model refutation remains conditional on length/source applicability
Caller checks only nonempty literal pattern; inspected zstring representation exposes unsigned length, not an asserted small-pattern bound
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.grounding_quote: continue; // re-examine same index (now the next request)
properties.inputs: queue: seq<int> request IDs; is_eq: seq<bool>; verdict: seq<int>; start: int; outputs queue_out, qhead_out, conflict
properties.whole_positive_property: Let stop=FirstConflict(queue,is_eq,verdict,start), or |queue| if absent. conflict == (stop < |queue|) AND queue_out == queue[..start] + FilterUnknown(queue[start..stop],verdict) + queue[stop..] AND qhead_out == (if conflict then start else |queue_out|) AND 0 <= qhead_out <= |queue_out|
required_helpers: Body-defined first-conflict and stable-unknown-filter specification helpers
Actual mutable queue scan, erase, same-index continuation and qhead adjustment
correspondence_limits: Bisimulation results are explicit environment observations for bookkeeping, not assumed proofs of regex equivalence
Prior prefix below start is deliberately not rescanned, as in source
No native allocator/AST lifetime or full trail-stack proof; scalar/vector value state only
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.grounding_quote: result = join(yes, nullable(r) ? length(0, k) : empty);
properties.inputs: word, allowed_characters: seq<int>; accepts_empty,last_index: bool; k: int; output rewritten_accepts: bool
domain: selected str.at fixed-nonnegative-index branch or exactly str.len(word)-1 branch; nullable helper succeeds
properties.whole_positive_property: rewritten_accepts == TargetAccepts(StrAt(word, if last_index then |word|-1 else k), allowed_characters, accepts_empty)
required_helpers: Body-defined str.at with negative/out-of-range behavior and guarded indexing
Body-defined target membership on epsilon and singleton words
Source regex cat/meet/union/length semantics for both selected branches; no opaque assumed rewrite result
correspondence_limits: Only epsilon/single-character membership of the arbitrary target language matters because str.at has length at most one
No proof of general regex implementation, nullable decision procedure, extraction/preimage branches or caller budget behavior
Integer alphabet abstracts equality of valid characters; no unsupported character-arithmetic claims
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.grounding_quote: // A single-character observation is unchanged when neither replacement operand contains it.
properties.inputs: word,needle,replacement: seq<int>; character: int; output rewritten_contains: bool
domain: selected admitted rewrite: nseq, no proof production/quantifiers, and no global blocked-replacement abort
required_helpers: Body-defined ground ReplaceFirst from zstring::replace, including empty needle, no match, first-only replacement, matching loop and copy/skip behavior
Body-defined character occurrence; preserve the real whole property, not merely a sufficient no-match case
correspondence_limits: This is the local observation rewrite; graph traversal, ancestor blocking, sharing, proof/model conversion and marks/lifetimes remain unproved
Character/string denotation only, not AST or allocator memory safety
Length bounds preserve selected unsigned helper arithmetic; do not assume nonempty needle
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.inputs: original: seq<int>; index: int; output restored: seq<int>
domain: the trail constructor records original[index] before exactly that slot is erased, as in req_facet::remove
properties.whole_positive_property: restored == original, with all modeled push/shift/store accesses in bounds
required_helpers: Body-defined actual vector erase-by-left-shift and pop
Record the erased value before mutation
Actual undo: push saved value, right-shift backwards, then write the saved slot; never replace the whole output with original
correspondence_limits: Value elements abstract movable request records; move/destructor/AST references and allocation failures are outside the model
Checks this new helper and its selected erase/undo path, not all apply_subst/dependency or nested trail behavior
Bounds are real index/size requirements, not assumptions that undo succeeds
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

properties.inputs: conjunction: bool; child_verdicts: seq<int>; output verdict: int; encoding -1=false,0=unknown,1=true
domain: selected nonempty-ground-word Boolean regex constructor branch after earlier source guards
properties.whole_positive_property: verdict == (if conjunction then (if -1 in child_verdicts then -1 else if 0 in child_verdicts then 0 else 1) else (if 1 in child_verdicts then 1 else if 0 in child_verdicts then 0 else -1))
required_helpers: Preserve source identity value, short-circuit decisive result, unknown accumulation, and loop order
Body-defined membership/aggregation specification; explicit observed child verdicts rather than hidden convenient child results
correspondence_limits: Boolean aggregation only; no work-counter/depth-budget proof, full regex acceptance, derivative or ground-slicing correctness
Resource failures may appear as unknown child observations, but their occurrence/cost is not modeled
This is not source-level regex soundness or native crash verification
properties.intent_origin: source-inferred hypothesis, not a quotation of PR intent

deferred: C05 callback-driven coherence: require a justified callback/object-lifetime model rather than a value-only proxy
C08 full substitution/dependency/qhead undo: caller aliasing and dependency graph contracts need further tracing
C10 full trichotomy word branches; C11 substitution acyclicity; C12 cache/core entailment; C13 complete model reconstruction
C14 split positive-decimal/length-bound properties; C04 unchanged derivative helpers are context only
